structured.answer: This site says outright that it can't yet work out or explain quite a lot of things. The ones that matter to me are the deposits: the "פיקדון מובנה" (מוצר מובנה), the foreign-currency deposit (פיקדון במטבע חוץ), the deposit tied to the dollar (צמוד דולר) and the savings policy (פוליסת חיסכון). The rest of the list, as far as I got: corporate bonds (אג"ח קונצרניות), Israel bonds (אגרת בונדס), gold and ETC, ביטוח מנהלים, insurance with profit sharing, taking a pension as one lump sum (היוון קצבה), dollar hedging (מנוטרלת מט"ח), a digital currency wallet, and investment management (מסלולי ניהול, מנהל תיקים). So I won't rely on it for my deposits. I'll ask you, and then the bank, and only then decide.

stuck.why: It says the rules for all these products are 'עוד בבדיקה' and the site 'לא מחשב אותם'. I wasn't sure if that means it won't explain them either, or only won't work out the numbers.

stuck.where: The 'מצב הכיסוי' sections with 'חסום: שאלה פתוחה אחת' and dates crossed out
stuck.why: Busy and full of small codes. I couldn't tell what's finished and what's still open.
Here the word פיקדון shows up. That worried me, because this is my kind of thing and it's on the 'not covered' list.
Maybe this is the savings plan the clerk talked me into. I couldn't be sure it's the same thing.
